<p align="center">The pump shudders into life. As the water drops, the voices recede into a drain too narrow for a person.</p>

<p align="center">You cross the exposed stones and take the copper coil. Beside it lies a strip of scorched ribbon matching the one on your key.</p>

<p align="center">A short stair leads to Elias's workshop. On its first step is a footprint facing the wrong way.</p>
